paper_title: Production of dark matter axions from collapse of string-wall systems
coupling_convention: f_a (F_a) in GeV vs m_a in eV
notes: Cosmological bound on the axion decay constant from collapse of string-wall systems. Main result: Fa <= (2.0-3.8)x10^10 GeV (Eq. 96), combined with astrophysical lower bound Fa >~ 10^9 GeV gives allowed window Fa ~ 10^9-10^10 GeV corresponding to m_a ~ 10^-3 to 10^-2 eV. Data points encode this allowed region on the f_a-m_a plane (approximate; the relation is m_a ~ 6e-6 eV / (Fa/10^12 GeV)). No exclusion plot with a coupling constant on the y-axis; primary result is on Fa itself, so AxionMass is appropriate.
